content: Let us use $X = (x_1, x_2, \dots , x_{|X|})$ to denote a document and use $Y = (y_1, y_2, \dots , y_{|Y|})$ to denote its summary. The encoder takes the document $X$ as input and transforms it to its contextual representations. The decoder learns to generate the summary $Y$ one token at a time based on the contextual representations and all preceding tokens that have been generated so far:
